scope: Point-in-time GPU process allocation; includes preallocated KV caches, excludes CPU-only allocations and other processes; not peak measured under demo recording and not total host usage.
method: Sum of nvidia-smi per-process GPU allocation for Qwen, Decider, Parakeet and demo/Light-ASD, divided by /proc/meminfo MemTotal. Unrelated Nemotron service excluded.
